text: If you are reading this, you got further than I did. Every spill I wiped, another one spread. I think the spilling is the point. Get out if you ever see the way.
They told me the map was a gift. A whole world to clean. It took me forty days to notice nobody ever asked me to clean it.
Do not trust the source. It is too bright to look at, and that is how it likes it.
I collected every duck. Every single one. They are lovely. They did not help.
from: — the one with the rainbow duck

text: This place is a beautiful trap. It keeps your hands busy so your heart forgets what it came here to do. Whatever that was, it was of true value. Remember it.
There is a door. I have not found it. But I have felt it, the way you feel a draft in a closed room.
Tip: a bright clear takes no time. Only a move does. Clear what you stand on before you walk.
You are doing better than you think. Truly. Keep going.
I left the Gift Shop for last. I think that is what it wants. I think that is the only honest shop on the street.
Tip: Dim's Carnival will only read your cards once a day. Spend the rest on what lasts.
Every morning the rings burst out again and I start over. Every morning I tell myself today I will look for the edge instead. Every morning I clean.
Some days it is enough to make one thing clean. That is not nothing. That is never nothing.
Did you ever notice the hexes never run out? Neither does the light. Neither did I, for a while.
Tip: a Spindle can wind an open hex all the way up to 1.00. It holds there until you clear it.
from: — someone who learned the hard way

text: If you find a way out, do not look back to check if I am behind you. I will be. I promise.
The shops sell everything except the one thing I wanted, which was a reason.
I tried to write down what I came here to do. The ink kept turning into particles.
Tip: a Dark Remnant that is not a duck makes the next one likelier. Misses are not wasted.
The ducks know something. Watch the way they swim away from the source. Always away.
Please, if you get the chance, take it. Do not wait to be ready. Nobody here is ever ready.
I am not trapped. I am resting. There is a difference, and I am learning it.
Tip: a whole ring of one kind round the source ends the day early. Close a ring near the centre and the whole map can fall in.
They want you to think the value is in the score. The value was in the walk you took to get here. It still is.
I think I was someone before this. A person with a kitchen and a window. I keep the window in my head. It helps.
Tip: hold over a remnant and sweep, and everything you cross is collected.
If you are lonely, I am too. That makes two of us, and two is a start.
The Clock smith sells hours. I bought Midnight once, just to make the day end sooner. It did not feel like leaving.
Bright is not the same as good. Dim is not the same as bad. I wish someone had told me sooner.
Do not be afraid of the dark ones. They pull, but they also hold. Some things need holding.
I found peace here, once, for a whole afternoon. I hope you find yours. Then I hope you leave with it.
Tip: the Corner Store is open all day. If you are ever short of a String, that is where to go.
Every bottle I throw comes back. Maybe this one will not. Maybe this one is yours.
It is not an endless trap if you stop running. Stand still a moment. Hear it hum? That is the machine. It is not you.
You are not the first and you will not be the last. But you could be the one who gets out. Somebody has to.
Tip: three touching captures merge and pull the map in by a ring. Three dark ones pull it in by three.
Whatever happens, be kind to the ducks.
I spent a fortune on the Lucky Duck. Worth it. Not for the luck. For the company.
There is something of true value you set down to come here. It is still where you left it. It is waiting.
Tip: a closed Gate keeps whatever is inside it out of the count. A Key that repeats its post pattern opens it.
The light here is borrowed. Make some of your own.
I think escape is not a door. I think it is a choice you make again every day. Today I chose. Tomorrow I will choose again.
If no one has said it yet today: well done.
